name: Historic Town of Grand-Bassam
description: Explore the historic urban landscape recognized for its role in the history of Côte d'Ivoire and its colonial-era architecture.

name: National Costume Museum
description: Discover traditional clothing, textiles, and cultural expressions associated with communities in Côte d'Ivoire.

name: Colonial Historic District
description: Observe the historic streetscape and architectural details that reflect Grand-Bassam's colonial-era urban development.

name: Grand-Bassam Beach
description: Experience the Atlantic coastline and enjoy the beach while respecting local safety advice and the marine environment.

name: Historic Administrative Buildings
description: Learn about the historic administrative role of Grand-Bassam by observing surviving buildings and their architectural features.

name: Traditional Fishing Activities
description: Learn about the importance of fishing and coastal livelihoods to local communities.

name: Local Craft Traditions
description: Discover craft traditions and locally made objects that express artistic skills and cultural identity.

name: Historic Commercial Streets
description: Explore streets associated with the town's historical commercial life and urban development.

name: Traditional Coastal Cuisine
description: Discover regional food traditions and coastal dishes offered by local food businesses.

name: Lagoon Environment
description: Learn about the lagoon environment, its landscapes, and its importance to the surrounding communities.

name: Historic Residential Architecture
description: Observe the designs and construction details of historic residential buildings from different periods.

name: Grand-Bassam Cultural Heritage
description: Explore the living traditions, community practices, and cultural expressions that shape the town's identity.

name: Coastal Landscape
description: Observe the coastal landscape and learn about the importance of protecting beaches and marine habitats.

name: Historic Urban Streetscape
description: Study the arrangement of streets and buildings that contribute to the character of the historic town.

name: Local Art and Creative Work
description: Discover local creative work and artistic expressions that connect contemporary life with cultural traditions.
